argv: mkdir -p /work && sshfs root@client:/client-workdir /work -p 2222 -o IdentityFile=/keys/id -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o reconnect -o ServerAliveInterval=1 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o dir_cache=no -o direct_io

import subprocess,os,signal,time,json
p=subprocess.Popen(['sh','-c','sleep 60 & wait'],start_new_session=True)
time.sleep(.2)
children=subprocess.check_output(['pgrep','-P',str(p.pid)],text=True).split()
os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
p.wait(timeout=3)
time.sleep(.2)
alive=[]
for pid in children:
 try:
  state=open('/proc/'+pid+'/stat').read().split()[2]
  if state!='Z': alive.append(pid)
 except FileNotFoundError: pass
print(json.dumps({'parent_exit':p.returncode,'children':children,'running_children':alive}))
